<![CDATA[
function insert$Retrieve$Items(g, r1, z, r2, columns, c1, c2) {
  var a1 = (columns + (c1 ? ',' + c1 : '')).split(','), a2 = (columns + (c2 ? ',' + c2 : '')).split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a1.length; i++) {
    var l1 = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a1[i])), l2 = z._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a2[i]));
    if (l1 > 0 && l2 > 0) z._setItemValue(r2, l2, g._getItemValue(r1, l1));
  }
}
function check$Retrieve$Items$DefaultMemvar(g, r, type, a) {
  if (type == 1 || !a) {
    return g.blankMemvar(r);
  } else {
    var i, j;
    if (g._rowCount < r) return !0;
    for (i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {if (g._getItemValue(r, g._getColumnOrder(a[i][0])) != (a[i][2] == 1 ? parseFloat(a[i][1]) : a[i][1])) return !1;}
    for (i = 0; i < g._fields.length; i++) {
      var t = g._fields[i], k = 0;
      for (j = 0; j < a.length; j++) {if (t.Name == a[j][0]) k += 1;}
      if (k == 0) {if ((!t.ReadOnly && !t.Hidden && !t.External || t.AllowContain) && g._getItemValue(r, i + 1)) return !1;}
    }
    return !0;
  }
  return !0;
}
]]>

Content:

function toolbar$]]>&GridExtraToolbarController;<![CDATA[$UpdateData(id) {
  var g = $find(id), row = g._activeRow, column = g._activeColumn, item = g._activeCell, field = item.field, name = field.Name, reference = g._getItem(row, g._getColumnOrder(field.ItemReference));
  var a = ]]>&GridExtraUpdateFields;<![CDATA[, r = '', script = '', formula = ]]>&GridExtraExpression;<![CDATA[;

  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    if ($func.trim(a[i][0]) == name) {
      var e = a[i];
      if (e.length > 1) r = a[i][1];
      if (e.length > 2) script = 'var id = "' + id + '";' + a[i][2];
      break;
    }
  }
  var expression = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < formula.length; i++) {
    if ($func.trim(formula[i][0]) == name) {
      expression = formula[i][1];
      break;
    }
  }

  var fields = r ? r.split(',') : [];
  for (var i = 1; i <= g._rowCount; i++) {
    var o = g._getItem(i, column);
    o.row = i;
    g._activeRow = i;
    if (g._getItemValue(i, column)) continue;

    var result = true;
    if (expression != '') result = g.calcExpression(i - 1, expression, true);
    if (result) {
      if ((field.HandleKey && o.classList.contains('When')) || !field.HandleKey || field.OnDemand) g.setItemGridBehavior(o, [[name, item.value, reference.value, true]]);
      for (var j = 0; j < fields.length; j++) {
        var index = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(fields[j]));
        if ((field.HandleKey && g._getItem(i, index).classList.contains('When')) || !field.HandleKey || field.OnDemand) g._setItemValue(i, index, g._getItemValue(row, index));
      }
      if (script) eval(script);
    }
  }
  g._activeRow = row;
  item.focus();
}
function toolbar$]]>&GridExtraToolbarController;<![CDATA[$DeleteData(id) {

    $func.detachControlBehavior(o);
    g._lastCell = o, g._activeCell = null, g._activeRow = -1; 
  }
  for (var i = g._rowCount; i > 0; i--) {
    g._removeRowNumber(i);
  }

}

}
